name: @soul-brews-studio/thclaws-paperclip-adapter
description: Paperclip adapter for thClaws — spawns the thclaws CLI directly via its OpenAI-compatible surface. Not a fork of the retired @thclaws/paperclip-adapter (which was tied to the discontinued thCompany.ai product); built from scratch against thClaws' generic POST /agent/run and OpenAI-compat surfaces, which survive that retirement unaffected.
